verdict.rationale: Grok Build saves every conversation to local disk (prompts, responses, tool calls, file snapshots). `grok export <session-id>` writes a session transcript as Markdown. Config lives in a plain `~/.grok/config.toml`, and project rules use the portable `AGENTS.md` convention, so leaving is low-friction. However, export is documented only per session, and nothing covers exporting or verifiably retrieving account or server-side data, such as uploaded repositories or shared session URLs. Missing for 10: a documented bulk/all-data export, export of server-side account data, structured (e.g. JSON) session export, and independent hands-on corroboration of the export flow.
